changelog.title: Spellblade balance pass
notes: Touch of Light (was Light Touch): duration up to 10s, now heals every 2 seconds instead of every second - same total healing.
Arcane Ignition: added a burning wound that deals extra Arcane damage over 6 seconds on every rank.
Arcane Ignition: direct-hit damage and mana cost rebalanced across all 8 ranks.
Spellblade Strike: weapon-damage bonus reduced from 120% to 110%.
Spellblade Strike: ranks 6-8 bonus damage significantly increased, and now varies within a range instead of a fixed number.

changelog.title: Universal cross-faction languages
notes: Every race can now speak and understand every language, across factions, from the moment a character is created.

changelog.title: Spellblade goes live + grimoire tiers
notes: Spellblade is now available on the main realm.
Each Spellblade grimoire tier now has its own icon and held model.

changelog.title: Launcher redesign
notes: The launcher got a full visual refresh - World of Razagath banner, textured panels, custom PLAY button and trim.

changelog.title: New Spellblade artwork
notes: New Spellblade class icon (character-creation screen, /who list, party frames).

changelog.title: Legendary grimoire
notes: New legendary off-hand: Grimoire of the Ascendant Spellblade (ilvl 284). Bought from Instructor Vaeryn for 100 Emblems of Frost at level 80 - best-in-slot for top raids.
Spellblade starter sword now shows the correct model on the character-creation screen.
Instructor Vaeryn's spawn no longer resets when world data is re-applied.

changelog.title: Spellblade launch
notes: The Spellblade class is now playable and selectable at character creation (Human, Night Elf, Draenei, Undead, Troll, Blood Elf).
Mandatory client patch: custom class tables, character-create screen, class icon, and the SpellBladeUI addon.
Client renamed to RazagathWoW; windowed mode is the default on first launch.
